notes: The first raid tier (opens 9 December 2026). size and log_zone are sourced facts: Blizzard's What's Next recap names Barrow Deeps a 10-player and Hyjal Summit a 20-player raid and Onyxia's Lair is 40; the combat log names Onyxia "Onyxia's Lair" and the other two log zones stay null until a log names them (tenet 8). Molten Core is not in this tier: it stays gated with the other Era raids (content-phases.json). opens is the phases.json phase each raid opens with (forever-raid-phases.json patches raid:onyxias-lair to raids-1; Blizzard's What's Next recap names all three for 9 December); a guild can post a raid only on or after that day. Dungeon runs and guild events live in events.json.
